Solution 01

Cassava Processing Systems

Integrated lines covering washing, drying, grinding and packaging of cassava flour.

Request a QuoteContact Our Team

01Overview

What this solution covers.

A cassava flour line moves product through four units: cleaning and washing, drying, grinding and packing. The reference configuration we work from also covers flow piping, air piping, PLC wiring and installation. Smarctek helps buyers define that scope and discuss it with equipment suppliers.

Application areas

  • Cassava flour production
  • Agro-processing plant planning
  • Project enquiries tied to a specific tonnage and site

02Process information

How the process runs.

  1. 01

    Cleaning and washing

    Raw cassava is received and cleaned before it moves on. The unit scope is defined per project.

  2. 02

    Drying

    Material is dried before milling. Drying capacity and layout depend on the project specification.

  3. 03

    Grinding and milling

    Dried product is reduced, ground and sifted by roller mills and plansifters.

  4. 04

    Packing

    Finished flour is weighed and bagged in 25–50 kg units.
